candidates.possible_change: Inspect whether the already-attempted structural comparisons can be reused locally while retaining the early successful check against either endpoint.
candidates.required_evidence: Preserve cases where the other endpoint is unresolved, both predicate policies, abort/precision behavior and cold/warm outcomes. No whole-helper rewrite or new scalar shortcut is proposed without these checks.
